claims.claim_vi: Redis is a data structures server: mutable data structures accessed with commands over TCP, served from memory but stored on disk, with tunable durability.
claims.verified_by: Read from a clone of redis/redis at tag 7.0.15 (commit f35f36a265403c07b119830aa4bb3b7d71653ec9).

claims.claim_vi: By default Redis 7.0.15 saves an RDB snapshot after 3600 s with at least 1 change, 300 s with 100, 60 s with 10000; appendonly is no; with AOF and the default fsync policy a power outage can lose about one second of writes.
claims.verified_by: Read from a clone of redis/redis at tag 7.0.15; CONFIG GET save and appendonly on a server started without a config file returned the same values.

claims.claim_vi: Redis Pub/Sub has at-most-once delivery: a message the subscriber cannot handle is lost; Streams offer stronger guarantees.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of redis/docs at commit 3b030c7ef066c0bb7f88ddec02c784e49783b0f8, the head of its default branch when read on 2026-10-18 (a later change to that branch does not alter this URL).

claims.claim_vi: On Redis 7.0.15: INCR returned 1 then 2; TYPE gave string, hash, list, set, zset; SADD with a duplicate left 2 members; RPOP after LPUSH a b returned a; ZREVRANGE gave binh 30, chi 20; a key SET with EX 1 was gone after 1.2 s; after SET user:1:name An, DELETE returned ERR unknown command while DEL returned 1; JSON.SET was an unknown command and MODULE LIST was empty; PUBLISH returned 0 with no subscriber and 1 with one, which received the message.
claims.verified_by: Experiment run by the author on 2026-10-18 on one virtual machine: redis-cli against Redis 7.0.15 (Ubuntu package) with persistence disabled for the command tests.

claims.claim_vi: Eight steps: what Redis is, adoption, persistence with RDB and AOF, data structures, basic commands including SET, GET, DELETE, INCR, HSET, modules, pub/sub, use cases.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

design_notes_vi: Ba khung: Redis là gì (chương trình, máy chủ, đĩa), năm kiểu dữ liệu đã thử, bốn điều dễ nhầm. Bảng lệnh và kết quả nằm trong bài.
source_deviations: Source lists DELETE as a basic command; Redis's command is DEL and DELETE is rejected (tested).
Source lists JSON among Redis data structures; in Redis 7.0.15 JSON needs a module (tested).
Source says Redis keeps fully durable storage; the lesson shows the default is periodic RDB snapshots that can lose recent writes.
Adopting companies and the module list are dropped: no source to check them.
